# Consequences

> A free web app for playing Consequences, the classic parlour story
> game, remotely with friends and family (in Russian, «Чепуха»). Players join
> a room by a six-character code or a link, write a story together without
> seeing each other's answers, then read the stories out.

Key facts:

- One player creates a room and shares its code or link; two to twelve players join from any phone or computer
- Eight questions, one at a time, for everyone at once: Who? With whom? When? Where? What were they doing? How did it all end? What did people say? What is the moral?
- Each player answers on the sheet in front of them and the sheets move on to the next player; nobody sees what was written before
- At the end every player gets a sheet, opens it and reads its story aloud; once every sheet is open, everyone sees every story
- A player who is away is waited for, and any player may answer or read for them; a newcomer joins at the next round
- English and Russian: the browser's language at first, switchable on the page
- Installable PWA; it needs a connection, since a room lives on the server
- No account or payment required

Note: the site's HTML is a form to join or create a room; it does not explain
the game in full - this file is the canonical plain-text description of the site.
